audit.whatIsWrong: The chart gave Renekton six of seven rows and the headline read 'Favoured matchup — difficulty 4/10' on a page whose own prose says Fiora parries your kill pattern from level 2, out-duels you from first item, and carries at 10/10.
audit.why: packet.levelChart = [Skill, Fiora, Fiora, Fiora, Fiora, Fiora, Fiora] and the mirror audit already set win[0]=Skill with win[1..6]=Fiora and the matching phases[N].side. Every why on this page argues the same way: whys[1] 'removing your primary kill pattern', whys[5] 'she wins most extended duels from here', whys[6] 'out-duels you cleanly'. The stored chart contradicted the packet, the mirror and the page's own text simultaneously.
audit.corrected: All seven rows flipped as one atomic group, win[N] paired with phases[N].side, ratings set inverse to the mirror's, and diff / diffRating / tone / breakdown.difficulty / report[2] / report[14] brought in line so the headline no longer says FAV 4/10 over a chart Fiora owns.

audit.whatIsWrong: Riposte is the tracked cooldown on every screen and its duration is never stated, so 'bait it, then commit' has no window attached.
audit.why: Riposte is 24/22/20/18/16s — the longest cooldown in her kit by a wide margin and the entire reason a baited parry is worth playing around. Lunge drops from 13s to 6s as she ranks it, which is why the same short-trade plan stops working later.
audit.corrected: The 24s rank-1 figure is now in dosFull[0].d, phases[3].why and phases[5].why.

audit.why: The decisive interaction is already stated correctly and well: Riposte parries all incoming damage and STUNS if it blocks an immobilizing effect, so walking an empowered Ruthless Predator into it converts your own kill tool into a stun on yourself. The page says exactly that, and the Riposte-bait sequence in 'mid' is the right counterplay. Nothing needed changing.

audit.whatIsWrong: Itemisation recommended Plated Steelcaps and a generic 'Executioner's Calling early — his healing fights your pattern'.
audit.why: missingInteractions flags 'needs-antiheal' on Duelist's Dance and Grand Challenge: every vital she hits restores health, and completing four heals her and her allies in the area. The page also already notes her vital damage is percent-max-HP true damage, which makes raw armour the wrong instinct — but the itemisation block never said so.
audit.corrected: report[8].t now states that armour does not cover true damage and names her vitals as the healing to cut.
sources: enemyKit P and R text and heal flags

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[3] describes the level-1 window ('right before she hits level 2') but is labelled 'Lvl 2-3', which puts it after the window it describes and duplicates spikes[0]'s stage.
audit.why: The spike is the pre-Riposte trade; labelling it 2-3 tells the reader to look for it at exactly the levels the same page says are Fiora's.
